MIGHTEE case #1 - MeerKAT L-band
MIGHTEE COSMOS field observed for 4 h with MeerKAT L-band (1.284 GHz, 856 MHz). Sky: MIGHTEE DR1 sources with deconvolved sizes plus T-RECS sources below MIGHTEE's completeness limit, trimmed to the 0.2 deg image. Thermal noise from per-antenna SEFDs (426 Jy, eta_c 0.98), ideal with no RFI flagging; expected natural-weight rms 1.4 uJy/beam.
